candidates.title: Medical documentation in a record system

demandEvidence.chore: Preparing medical documentation in the COSMIC record system, using fictional records only in any prototype.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Du ansvarar i huvudsak för den medicinska dokumentationen i journalsystemet COSMIC

ease.reason: The task names a specialized record system; a beginner could only model document formatting with fictional data.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: health offices might value admin support; this vacancy does not show AI-service demand or purchases.

feasibility.reason: A fictional text mock could fit two weeks, but the notice gives no document format or bounded subtask.

autonomy.reason: A draft might be repeatable, but qualified staff must verify every document and any real system use is out of scope.

evidence.reason: The official vacancy names medical documentation and COSMIC, but reports no workflow frequency or automation.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (mean 3.2): the notice names documentation in a specialized system but does not bound a safe useful experiment beyond a fictional mock; no AI-service demand is established.

candidates.title: Appointment booking and document handling

demandEvidence.chore: Booking visits and handling referrals, post and copies of medical records; any prototype must use fictional records only.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Vi lägger tidböcker och bokar besök till läkare, sjuksköterskor samt ortoptister

ease.reason: A fictional appointment-request sorting mock is accessible, though real booking-system access is not established.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: clinics may value help with booking administration; the vacancy shows human work, not AI purchases.

feasibility.reason: A mock intake and draft booking queue could fit two weeks; live calendars and record systems remain out of scope.

autonomy.reason: Sorting and preparing a draft queue could repeat, but a staff member must verify identity, availability and every action.

evidence.reason: The notice explicitly lists booking visits and handling referrals, post and record copies, without frequency or automation evidence.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (mean 4.4): this is the clearest bounded chore, but only a fictional intake and draft queue is supportable; live booking, health data and AI-service demand are unestablished.
